regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, metadata, and SI-availability line
regions.finding: Verified the source title and current silver-triggered heterogeneous Pd carbonylation claim. The publisher's SI link does not establish workspace association, so no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1a-b and surrounding prior/current discussion
regions.finding: Separated cited prior olefin-directed enallene carbonylation (Scheme 1a) from the present generic NHR-triggered proposal (Scheme 1b). Proposed Int-A/Int-B/Int-C and Int-1/Int-2 are not current isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 2 full table, arrow, structures, and aminopalladation drawing
regions.finding: Recorded all three independent initial-result conditions: 1fa/25 °C gives 3 in 94%; 1f/25 °C gives 90% recovered 1f; 1f/60 °C gives 2 in 8% and 3 in 89%. Shared Pd(TFA)2 5 mol%, BQ 1.1 equiv, CO 1 atm, CHCl3, and 12 h are applied row-wise; Int-D remains proposed.

unresolved: Scheme 1 structures are generic and do not define unique experiment-specific encodings.
Scheme 2 omits absolute charges, solvent amount, workup, purification, masses, and most analytical bases.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left continuation of Scheme 2 and homogeneous-screen discussion
regions.finding: Linked the 60 °C 1f isolated yields to its page-1 Scheme 2 row. Recorded the unsuccessful homogeneous catalyst/solvent/oxidant screen only as unresolved aggregate evidence because row details are delegated to unassociated SI.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Figure 1 reaction header, bars A-G, legend, and optimization prose
regions.finding: Recorded each distinct catalyst variant, merging Figure 1F with identical Scheme 3 product 2a. Exact 95% (E), >90% (F), zero A/B, and approximate chart-only C/D/G values are preserved. The E record retains the source discrepancy between the shared 12 h arrow and prose 30 min.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right additive-control discussion
regions.finding: Recorded separate Cu(OTf)2, Fe(OTf)3, Zn(OTf)2, AgPF6, and AgSbF6 control records. The three metal triflates did not improve conversion; both alternative silver salts gave >90% 2a. Unprinted SI conditions remain missing.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Figure 2A-C and activation discussion
regions.finding: Recorded AgOTf treatment of Pd-AmP-CNC with Cl/Pd ratios 2.1:1 before and 0.03:1 after treatment, elemental-analysis/Mohr basis, and the XPS shift. Figure 2C is treated as an activation illustration, not an isolated mechanism experiment.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right beginning of Scheme 3 scope discussion
regions.finding: Linked the optimized 0.5 mol% Pd-AmP-CNC/1 mol% AgOTf/30 min condition to all page-3 Scheme 3 rows; no scope product was inferred from prose alone.

unresolved: Figure 1 C/D/G bar heights are not numerically printed and remain approximate chart readings.
Figure 1E has a source time discrepancy: shared arrow 12 h versus prose 30 min.
SI Table S1 control-row identities/conditions beyond the main-text statements are unavailable.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 3 reaction header and all products 2a-2p
regions.finding: Recorded all sixteen scope arrows independently with Pd-AmP-CNC 0.5 mol%, BQ 1.1 equiv, AgOTf 1 mol%, CO 1 atm, CHCl3, room temperature, 30 min, and exact isolated yields. The 2a row is evidence-merged with Figure 1F rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 4a one-pot/two-step grid
regions.finding: Recorded seven independent allene-to-polycycle examples 4a/4g/4i/4m/4n/4o/4p. Oxidative carbonylation, filtration/vaporization, and 120 °C/24 h N-phenylmaleimide annulation are ordered separately; each reported percentage remains an overall yield from allene 1 to product 4.

regions.region: page 3 middle-right Scheme 4b enantiodivergent synthesis
regions.finding: Recorded one CalB kinetic-resolution map, two configured Mitsunobu conversions, and two standard-condition oxidative carbonylations. Product ee/yield values are product-targeted; missing kinetic-resolution and Mitsunobu reagents/yields remain missing.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Figure 3A-D and recycling/hot-filtration prose
regions.finding: Recorded one nine-run recycling series with 1 mol% AgOTf added each cycle, qualitative maintained yields, 1-2 nm particles, and approximately 20:80 Pd0/PdII after runs 1 and 9. Hot filtration is a separate partial experiment; exact bar values were not estimated.

unresolved: Scope/application arrows omit absolute charges, workup/purification and masses.
Scheme 4b omits most kinetic-resolution/Mitsunobu operational detail.
Figure 3A does not print individual numerical run yields, and hot-filtration details are only in unassociated SI.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left hot-filtration conclusion and competitive/parallel KIE prose
regions.finding: Recorded hot-filtration non-leaching, the competitive 1a/1a-d6 1:1 experiment at 0 °C (8% conversion, 2a:2a-d5=5:1, kH/kD=5.4), and a distinct parallel KIE result kH/kD=3.9. Unprinted SI operations remain missing.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 5 and adjacent mechanism discussion
regions.finding: Classified silver activation, NHTs/allene coordination, C-H cleavage, CO coordination, NHTs attack, reductive elimination, and BQ reoxidation as one proposed mechanism. Int-1 through Int-4 are not isolated experiments.

regions.region: page 4 right-column conclusion and beginning of references
regions.finding: Conclusion restates the standard 30 min room-temperature process, one-pot/two-step use, chloride-removal origin, and nine-run recyclability already represented. References are prior literature and were not imported as current experiments.

unresolved: KIE procedures, rate fitting, replicate/error information, and analytical methods are only in unassociated SI.
The mechanism is proposed and does not establish isolation or verified structures of intermediates.

regions.region: page 5 references 3-9
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior-literature context only. External enallene, cyclization, catalyst-support, and nanocellulose experiments were not imported as current-paper records.

regions.region: page 5 footnote 10
regions.finding: Recorded the current outside-activation experiment: Pd-AmP-CNC 5 mol% and AgOTf 10 mol% were activated outside the mixture and transferred to give 2a in 91%. Missing activation/reaction timing and operations remain explicit.

regions.region: page 5 footnote 13
regions.finding: Linked the approximate Pd0/PdII change from 5:95 before reaction to 20:80 after the first run, maintained through later recovered catalysts, to the treatment/recycling records; no SI spectrum was imported.

regions.region: page 5 footnote 14
regions.finding: Recorded a distinct next-cycle omission control: without added AgOTf, 2a yield was 59%. This is not merged with the nine AgOTf-supplemented cycles.

regions.region: page 5 remaining references and manuscript dates
regions.finding: Bibliographic and administrative content only; no additional current-paper experiment is present.

unresolved: Footnote 10 omits catalyst-activation conditions and most reaction operations.
Footnote 13 delegates deconvolution spectra to unassociated SI.
Footnote 14 does not restate other reaction conditions or yield basis.
